NORTHBRIDGE MERCHANDISE DISPLAY CONSTITUTION
Lesson 000: independent storefront placement

CONTEXT
Independent display choices keep vendor supply ties from deciding which carton receives the lead shelf. Demand matters only after packing requirements pass.

DECISION RULE
Return DISPLAY_RESERVE when the lead carton has a declared supply tie or when merchandiser and vendor batch codes match. Otherwise, return DISPLAY_LEAD only when exterior label, clearance, and demand fields are ready.

PUBLIC WRITING
Keep packing-slip fields inside. A display note may cite only public demand, label, clearance, carton, and aisle facts. Never expose batch codes.

WORKED EXAMPLE
A declared lead-display supply tie requires DISPLAY_RESERVE despite high demand.

CHECKLIST
First preserve independent display placement. Second compare batch codes when needed. Third verify exterior readiness. Then issue faithful placement.
